title: "Cursor cloud agents"
description: "Let an Agent SDK agent hand coding work to Cursor cloud agents and steer them: mount the extension and pick the repositories it may touch."

# Cloud agents

The `cursor-cloud-agents` extension lets an Agent SDK agent hand coding work to
Cursor cloud agents. A cloud agent works in a repository checkout and pushes
branches and pull requests while your agent keeps talking to the person.

## Mount it

```ts
// bot/extensions/cloud.ts
import cursorCloudAgents from "@grok/agent-sdk/extensions/cursor-cloud-agents";

export default cursorCloudAgents({
  cloud: {
    repos: [{ url: "https://github.com/acme/api", startingRef: "main" }],
    autoCreatePR: true,
  },
});
```

Launches run under the host's signed-in account (`agent-sdk login`,
`CURSOR_API_KEY`, or `CURSOR_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY`) and spend its cloud-agent
budget.

## What the agent can do

With the extension mounted, the agent can launch a cloud agent on a repository
or pull request, check its status, read its conversation and edits, steer or
stop it, and list the agents it launched. A bundled skill teaches the model when
to delegate and how to write a brief a cloud agent can act on alone.

Each caller can only see and steer the cloud agents they launched. If every
caller uses the same bearer token, the extension treats them all as one person.
Use [authored auth](../reference/channels.md#auth-policies) to keep callers
apart.

When a cloud agent the conversation launched stops, the extension wakes that
conversation once. The wake message gives the agent id and its status, and
tells the model to call `cloud__get`. That tool returns the agent's `result`,
the final answer of its latest run.

On Cursor hosting, the wake comes when the agent's run stops. This includes a
run that someone else cancels. If the wake does not reach the conversation,
the extension tries again every minute, up to 10 times. You configure nothing
for this.

Nothing polls the agent. If no wake comes, ask the bot to check the agent with
`cloud__get`. A stop in the middle of a turn does not wake the conversation
yet. The extension stops waiting for a wake after 24 hours.

Some launches get no wake: launches off Cursor hosting, launches from a mount
that sets its own `apiKey`, and launches with `envVars`. A launch that Cursor
hosting cannot watch also gets no wake. For these launches, the launch result
says `watching: false`. Ask the bot to check the agent when you need its
result.

## Read a result from your code

Your own code, such as a tool or a reminder, can launch a cloud agent with
`launchCloudAgent` and read it back with `getCloudAgent`. When the agent has
stopped and its latest run finished, `result` holds the final answer of that
run. An errored or expired run has no `result`. Ask the agent to end with its
report or its JSON, and parse `result`.

```ts
import { getCloudAgent } from "@grok/agent-sdk/extensions/cursor-cloud-agents";

const agent = await getCloudAgent(agentId);
if (agent.status === "finished" && agent.result !== undefined) {
  const report = JSON.parse(agent.result);
}
```

`getCloudAgent` does not check who launched the agent. Pass only ids that your
code launched, never an id that a model chose.

`launchCloudAgent` takes an optional `agentId`, a `bc-<uuid>`. When you omit
it, the extension makes one. To retry a launch that timed out or failed, pass
the same `agentId` again. If the first launch created the agent, you get that
agent back and no second agent starts. The extension returns an existing agent
only when this principal launched it through the extension. A launch with
`cloud.envVars` cannot take an `agentId`.

## Configure it

| Option | What it controls |
| --- | --- |
| `cloud` | Launch defaults for repositories, environment, and pull request behavior. |
| `cloud.repos` | The repositories the agent may hand work to, each with a default branch or pull request. Without it, launches run with no repository, so secrets in `cloud.envVars` never reach a repository you didn't list. |
| `cloud.teamMcpServers` | Up to 50 team MCP server names that launched agents may use, matched case-insensitively. Omit it to allow every team server the account can use. Personal servers and `cloud.mcpServers` aren't filtered. |
| `model` | The model launched agents run. Omit it to use the account default. |
| `apiKey` | A Cursor API key to launch with instead of the host's own. |

## Adjust it

To remove a capability such as sending follow-ups, mount the extension as a
directory and disable that tool. See
[Adjust a mounted extension](../reference/extensions.md#adjust-a-mounted-extension).
